about: How each part of the game reaches village life and conversation. tools/integrate.mjs compares this with the game; docs/social-integration.md says how to act on the differences. status: active = in the game now; historical = gone from the game but remembered (labels kept, nothing generates or offers it).

crime-and-law.describe: Stealing, sneaking, sabotage and the town watch that catches people for it.

integrations.see: witnesses near the act (lfEmit); anonymous acts (anon) leave the victim's household suspecting somebody (sbPilfer)
integrations.hear: told on as gossip (SBX.news, lf2Tell); culprits can be swapped on the way (sbPassOn scapegoat)
integrations.remember: each person's own version (o.kn: who, cert, sus); serious ones are never forgotten (sbImp)
integrations.opinion: theft/deceit/crime tags lower liking and trust (lf2Feel, sbTrust); grudges (life2/grudges)
integrations.gossip: high spice; versions differ; 'the wrong person blamed' in sift
integrations.talk: cvTellEvent with hedges, suspects (layer 1), 'I heard it was X' (cvContradict), the guard's arrest talk

accepted.escape: opinion: an escape is judged through the arrest before it, not on its own

quarrels-and-kindness.describe: How villagers treat each other day to day: rows, insults, shoves, help, gifts, comfort.

integrations.see: witnesses; family rows are heard by the household
integrations.remember: versions and the reason ledger (o.why: 'argument', 'comforted me')
integrations.opinion: lfAff with reasons; second-order beliefs (o.sbRel) for people who hear of it
integrations.gossip: quarrels and brawls travel; kindness travels less
integrations.talk: event telling, 'X cannot stand Y, ever since…' (cvTellRel), 'today I had words with…' (cvTellConv)

romance.describe: Crushes, flirting, courting, affairs and jealousy.

integrations.see: witnesses; trysts are hidden unless seen
integrations.gossip: high spice, exaggerated on the way
integrations.talk: romance rules in cv-rules; 'X is sweet on Y'; flirting as an attitude

money.describe: Coins changing hands: loans, debts, dice, windfalls, lost and found money, the dole.

integrations.see: the two people involved (and dice tables)
integrations.remember: loans in town.sbLoans; reasons 'unpaid loan', 'paid me back', 'lent me money'
integrations.opinion: trust rises when repaid, falls when late (sbDaily)
integrations.talk: money rules in cv-rules; 'I had to ask X for a loan' (cvTellConv); reasons when asked about someone

accepted.dole: opinion: taking the dole is no shame here; it is news, not a judgement

health.describe: Falling ill, being nursed, getting better.

integrations.talk: health rules in cv-rules; busy/ill people brush you off (cvBusy)

accepted.recovered: opinion: getting better is good news, nobody is judged for it

integrations.talk: smell and embarrass rules in cv-rules

secrets.describe: Each villager's secret (cv-world) and what happens when one leaks.

integrations.see: nobody: secrets are confided (SBX.confide) or leaked (SBX.leak)

work-and-trade.describe: Jobs, the businesses that sell things, and the goods they make and sell.

integrations.see: colleagues at work (SBX.shop, presim work groups)
integrations.hear: a good or bad week, deliveries and catches are news
integrations.remember: versions; rivalry reasons ('competition'); a business that shuts becomes a 'closed' event (history: remembered and gossiped, no longer offered as current); a change of trade is a 'newjob' event, and 'used to be the baker' in talk (sbWatchWorld)
integrations.opinion: respect (sbResp) between colleagues; rivalry in the same trade
integrations.talk: activity talk (CV_ACTV), job names (LF2_JOBS name / JOB_NOUN), 'the shop is out of bread' (cvWorldTopics), busy at work (cvBusy), job changes ('newjob')

accepted.delivery: opinion: a delivery is news about the shop, not about anybody
